dict.string: Aurora reads selected commitments to help review your day. It changes an event only after you approve its preview.

If you turn them on, Aurora reads Sleep Analysis and dietary caffeine from Apple Health to show your records, compare sleep with your target and estimate alertness. Imported records stay read-only in Aurora and stay on this device.
If you turn it on, Aurora adds caffeine you save in Aurora to Apple Health, and updates or removes only those entries. It never changes data from other apps or devices.
Aurora uses the microphone only while you dictate a request on this device.
Aurora transcribes your requests on device. It does not send audio to cloud speech services.
